name: editorial-motion
vibe: A luxury print-magazine kinetic-typography film set on living paper. A warm cream ground with a faint drifting column grid, floating paper grain and a soft edge-vignette flows unbroken behind every page, and a persistent running-head + folio chrome (KeyFrame · The AI Video Issue · Vol. 01 · keyframe.ai) carries continuity across every cut. Oversized high-contrast serif headlines reveal word-by-word with the last word set in a brand-accent italic, hairline rules draw across the column, mono section and issue labels sit in the margins, editorial pull-quotes land with a giant quotation mark, and ruled figure plates hold real screenshots behind a paper-wipe with a thin rule and a mono caption. A colophon CTA closes on a solid ink button. Everything is theme-driven, so the brand color repaints the whole issue — the drawn rules, the accent-text kickers, the highlighted italic words, the pull-quote mark, the chrome rules and the CTA arrow, not just body copy. Portrait-native 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Rendered as a native GSAP + canvas composition. Best for refined, print-inspired, high-contrast brands, editorial launches, feature stories, thought-leadership and anything that should feel like a magazine spread in motion.
